diagnosis: Survivor is roughly breakeven overall (50.7% win, -$68.37 across 404 trades) but the pure MOMENTUM strategy is the clear drag: 383 trades, 49% win, -$55.81, while ARB (92% win, +$5.89) is tiny but strongly profitable and underused. The lesson engine has correctly identified and is now vetoing the worst bucket (move10-20: 28/81 win, -$33.47 expectancy -0.41) and price<0.45 (19/62 win, -$19.54), which is good. However recent decision logs show the bot still entering trades in the 'move<10' bucket range (expectancy -0.045, 123 trades) and at prices in the 0.55-0.70 band (expectancy -0.086, 84 trades) without a hard veto — these are validated losing buckets but only flagged 'none'. Exits are dominated by take-profit (0.90) and stop-loss hits with very short time-left (60-120s), consistent with the 'left60-120' bucket being a validated loser (21/59 win, -$20.25) and 'left<60' being catastrophic (2/13 win, -$19.40, expectancy -1.49) though still 'collecting' status. Coin-level performance is highly skewed: BTC is the only solid profit center (60% win, +$10.83 over 77 trades) while DOGE is the worst (39% win, -$23.45 over 71 trades) and SOL/XRP are modest losers. The bot is not differentiating position sizing or entry thresholds by coin, treating DOGE and BTC identically despite a 21-point win-rate gap. The 'all-agree' bucket (50/112, -$18.99) is counterintuitively a loser despite high peer confidence, suggesting the peer-agreement signal may be stale or lagging, inflating confidence without edge. Current parameters are too loose on time-decay risk (min_entry_left_sec=140 is barely above the 150s typical window, and stop_loss_min_left_sec=60 lines up exactly with the toxic left60-120 bucket) and momentum_min_move_bps=30 config doesn't match observed reality where moves of 6-20bps are still being entered (move10-20 is vetoed but move<10, which is also negative expectancy, is not).
priorityActions: 1) Tighten entry filters: block/reduce move<10bps trades immediately given $5.55 in validated losses and no offsetting upside — this is a low-risk, high-confidence change
2) Reduce or pause DOGE trading (or require stricter confidence/edge thresholds specifically for DOGE) given -$23.45 P&L and 39% win rate — the single worst-performing coin by a wide margin

3) Audit whether 'left60-120' and 'left<60' vetoes apply to stop-loss/exit timing, not just entries — recent EXIT logs show stop-losses firing with 60-120s left repeatedly, which is the exact toxic zone; if entries are allowed up to 140s left and the window is 300s total, entries at 140-150s left naturally decay into the 60-120s zone before resolution

4) Scale up ARB/ARB_LEG allocation — ARB has 92% win rate and positive expectancy on only 13 trades; if arb_enabled and sizing allow, increasing ARB frequency/capital could offset MOMENTUM losses with a proven edge

5) Re-validate confidence scoring against the all-agree finding (-$18.99 despite being 'all-agree') — the peer-agreement signal may need reweighting or removal from the confidence formula since it's anti-predictive at scale
6) Consider raising min_edge toward the upper bound (currently 0.08, already at bound) is maxed, so focus on move-size and price-band filters instead since edge filtering alone hasn't closed the gap
